name: Zombusterz.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Zombusterz is a free iogame. Sometimes it's just you, your fists, and an angry army of undead punks who are heck-bent on devouring the living. If you want to survive you'll need more than just your wits. Collect various items, ammunition, and upgrades that will put you one notch above the rest. At first, you think you can take the zombies on one at a time. But you'll quickly realize that it's never just one on one. As soon as you enter into fisticuffs the other zombies will get wind and they begin to horde you, they begin to swirl around you and tear you apart. This is why you need to think ahead and move fast. Collect your weapons, take potshots at the zombies from behind. Its never a fair fight anyway so why pretend. Get could with your weapons because you're not going to be able to punch your way out of this one. Stay frosty as you avoid any dead-end entanglements. And watch out for big zombies. The zombies who have grown large by feasting on living flesh. Do not engage with the giants unless you're armed to the teeth and ready to rock and roll.
